name: jev-gate
description: Evaluate any selection, file, or saved file against typed TypeSafe Jev questions (noul/choice/score) straight from VS Code. Same API and batch semantics as the opencode jev tool.

jev.keyFile.description: Optional override path to the Jev API key file (default: ~/.config/opencode/.secrets/jev.key). JEV_API_KEY env takes precedence.

jev.questions.description: Inline typed questions map {id:{type,instructions,criteria}}. Leave empty to use .jevgate/questions.json in the workspace.

jev.state.description: Optional fallback state text when there is no active editor/selection.

jev.runOnSave.enabled.description: Automatically evaluate files on save (matching jev.runOnSave.extensions) against the current questions.

jev.runOnSave.extensions.description: File extensions (e.g. ["json","py"]) whose saves trigger a Jev evaluation.
